scope: Independent source review plus output hash, coverage, ratio arithmetic, CI ordering and summary reconciliation; did not execute analysis or repeat bootstrap

checks.score: W=sum(smp*k*absolute error); baseline-specific relative change, no revenue denominator substituted
checks.three_seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean prediction before absolute error; identical base predictions across seeds asserted and fold W reproduced
checks.alpha: Saved primary alpha applied unchanged to primary and recent; no alpha optimization in analysis
checks.chronology: Reads saved prediction columns only through 2025-03-01 00:00KST; no training imports/native inference/late-label reader
checks.join_and_time: Unique ts,grp predictions and weather, cross-seed template alignment; metadata schemas independently observed Asia/Seoul timezone; subtract one hour for hour-ending month/week
checks.strata: Month points, group and fixed forecast cloud/rain/temperature strata; daylight weather finite checks, night separate
checks.paired_bootstrap: 2000 whole-calendar-week resamples per scope, common multiplicities for both predictions and groups/weather; ratio of resampled monetary error sums
checks.periods: Primary/recent kept separate; only disjoint quarter target windows concatenated; difference from equal-quarter selection metric explicitly documented
checks.conditional_limits: Intervals condition on saved models and selected alpha, unadjusted many comparisons, previously exposed history and overlapping periods, exchangeability/seasonality caveat
checks.selection: All288 included; zero eligible and no candidate/coefficients/reselection changes
checks.outputs: 8 hash-matching detail parts,36 recipes each,288 unique IDs,5 comparison types per recipe; every output point-ratio and CI ordering checked; all-strata aggregate counts reconciled

analysis_attempt_correction.issue: Initial analysis reader expected p_reference on quarter prediction files; metadata independently confirms quarter files omit this annual-only column
analysis_attempt_correction.resolution: Read protected reference only for primary/recent; quarter comparison remains corrected prediction versus raw base. Retry preserves prior input manifest and demands identical artifact hash and file-stat maps
analysis_attempt_correction.classification: Analysis-only schema retry; not a training failure or new training run

limits: Read-only review and output reconciliation do not independently recompute bootstrap intervals or certify official leaderboard improvement.
Analysis itself recomputed8064 fold/blend W checks from11232 saved prediction files; reviewer inspected implementation/output evidence without repeating those reads.
